summary: Searches coordinate tables via MultiTableCoordinateSearch(a1, a2, a3, a4); on success stores the input tuple and the returned index into five globals and returns 0; on search failure (negative result) returns 1 without storing. Called by VidMan_Enter.

operations.description: Invoke MultiTableCoordinateSearch(a1, a2, a3, a4); result captured in local v4.
If search result v4 is negative, treat the coordinate lookup as failed.
Return 1 when the coordinate search reports no match.
Store input a1 into dword_5D6D60 (first match coordinate).
Store input a2 into dword_5D6D64 (second match coordinate).
Store input a3 into dword_5D6D68 (third match coordinate).
Store search result index v4 into dword_8AFE74.
Store input a4 into dword_8AFE78 (fourth match coordinate).
Return 0 when the match was found and the globals were stored.

clean_pseudocode: dword_5D6D60 = a1; dword_5D6D64 = a2; dword_5D6D68 = a3;
unresolved: Purpose of the five stored globals beyond caching a coordinate lookup is not established.
Relationship of caller VidMan_Enter to the coordinate cache is outside this function's scope.
